findings.current: …कई एजेंटों पर साथ-साथ काम शुरू करवाना…
findings.problem: 'पर' makes the agents the surface the work is started on ('work started onto several agents'); the English says parallel work spread ACROSS agents, i.e. they are the workers. Recoverable but the card is read at a glance.
findings.suggestion: कई एजेंटों में साथ-साथ काम शुरू करवाना (या कई एजेंटों के बीच), rest unchanged

findings.problem: The quotes sit on अनुभव only, so उपयोगकर्ता is read as the possessor ('the user of a change') and the head noun is lost; the settled compound उपयोगकर्ता अनुभव (user experience) is the thing under review. 'देखना' also drops review to 'seeing' where every other agent key says समीक्षा.
findings.suggestion: किसी बदलाव के “उपयोगकर्ता अनुभव” की समीक्षा करना — rest of the sentence unchanged

findings.current: …दावों का आधार, और AI जैसी बनावटी बातें हटाना।
findings.problem: 'AI-isms' becomes 'AI-like artificial things' (बातें = things/talk), losing the writing object that every other criterion in the list has; हटाना then hangs off the end of the list as if it were the whole sentence's verb. Same wording as the sibling descriptions key, so the two families agree — the defect is shared, not divergent.
findings.suggestion: …दावों का आधार, और AI जैसी बनावटी भाषा हटाना। (language, not 'things')

findings.problem: ढ is written without its nukta; standard Hindi has ढूँढ़ना and the hi style guide makes nukta part of the spelling ('keep nukta consistently'). House-wide rather than new: the merged hi catalogue has the same spelling in ui.teamBridge and ui.agents.descriptions (2 occurrences) and no nukta form anywhere, so this should be fixed once, house-wide.
findings.suggestion: ढूँढ़ना in all three keys, and in the two merged occurrences in the same change

findings.current: …और बिना और फ़ैसलों के पूरा हो सके।
findings.problem: 'बिना और फ़ैसलों के' is a calque of 'without further decisions'; Hindi wants a determiner and the oblique singular here.
findings.suggestion: …और बिना किसी और फ़ैसले के पूरा हो सके।

findings.problem: Flattens 'keyboard-first' to 'keyboard-driven'; the priority claim (the keyboard decides the design) is lost. Identical wording to the sibling descriptions key, so fixing one should fix both.

findings.current: …स्क्रीन या टर्मिनल UI की समीक्षा, लेआउट, स्पेसिंग, रंग या टेक्स्ट ठीक लगते हैं या नहीं…
findings.problem: The 'whether …' clause is dropped after a comma, so it reads as another list member beside 'the review', not the question the review asks.
findings.suggestion: …की समीक्षा कि लेआउट, स्पेसिंग, रंग या टेक्स्ट ठीक लगते हैं या नहीं…

findings.current: किसी PR, MR, diff, commit रेंज या पैच में…
findings.problem: The artefacts are treated three ways in one line: PR/MR/diff Latin, 'commit' Latin with a Devanagari रेंज, पैच transliterated. The context note keeps the team's own abbreviations; one policy per line would read cleaner.
findings.suggestion: किसी PR, MR, diff, commit range या patch में… (all Latin), or transliterate the whole set consistently
